source: Study of the Momentum Effect and the Reversal Effect on the Chinese Stock Market

factors.name: reversal_effect
factors.definition: The tendency for stocks that have performed poorly in the past to outperform in the future after a certain period.

methodology: Based on the BSV model and empirical testing of momentum and reversal strategies.
limitations: Short trading history relative to other markets.
Active trading environment introduced in 2010 may skew results.
